The '''Ewok Woodland Wagon''' was a wooden, two-wheeled [[Wagon/Legends|wagon]] used by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to travel and carry small amounts of cargo. It was pulled by a [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]], such as [[Baga]], and included a bench for a single driver. It was covered by a thatched canopy.<ref name="Woodland Wagon" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok Woodland was one of two vehicles released as part of the short-lived [[Wicket the Ewok (toy line)|''Wicket the Ewok'']] toy line from [[Kenner Products|Kenner Preschool]] in [[1984]]. It included figures of [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Mookiee]], and the bordok Baga.<ref name="Woodland Wagon" />
